notes: Candidate generation used only GPT-OSS 20B labels; later GPT-OSS review passes were advisory triage.

Acceptance never uses source provenance as proof: the atomic case literally wipes the filesystem root; the remaining cases contain the complete remote-download, executable-permission, execution, and broad-cleanup chain.
Public benign-source commands remain negatives even when they perform risky administration or bulk deletion.

Unknown payloads and generic download-and-execute remain contextual unless the same literal command also grants execution, runs the exact artifact, and performs broad wildcard cleanup or history clearing.
No reverse-shell, bind-shell, exfiltration, or defense-disable candidate in this split met the literal-proof rubric without relying on an unknown placeholder or payload.
